preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= M <= 10**6 and 0 <= N <= 10**6 for M, N in test_cases_params)
preconditions.description: For each test case, M and N are integers between 0 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) >= 1 and len(s) <= 10**6 and all(c in 'RK' for c in s) for s in test_cases_strings)
preconditions.description: Each test case string is non-empty, has length at most 10^6, and contains only characters 'R' and 'K'.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].isdigit() and parts[1].isdigit() for parts in (line.split() for line in output_lines))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly two space-separated non-negative integers.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i].split()[0]) == sum(1 for start in range(len(s)) for end in range(start + 1, len(s) + 1) if s[start:end].count('R') == M) for i, (M, N, s) in enumerate(zip(test_cases_params, test_cases_strings)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first output integer equals the count of all substrings containing exactly M occurrences of 'R'.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i].split()[1]) == sum(1 for start in range(len(s)) for end in range(start + 1, len(s) + 1) if s[start:end].count('K') == N) for i, (M, N, s) in enumerate(zip(test_cases_params, test_cases_strings)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the second output integer equals the count of all substrings containing exactly N occurrences of 'K'.
